messages:
alex: Heads up — Granite reported p99 token latency up ~2.1x and throughput -20% after the 03:12 UTC deploy. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/GR-4521. Anyone able to triage?

deploy-bot: deployed commit 0f3a7b2 -> prod at 03:12 UTC (canary -> global) :rocket:

maya: on it. is the regression global or region-limited?

lia: only eu-west-1 so far. customer says it started ~03:18 UTC and appears to affect streaming workloads (chunked responses) more than non-streaming.

ingrid: could be a KV-cache / kernel-selection interaction. if streaming p99 climbs but average ok, check for KV eviction spikes and attention kernel fallback. @maya can you grab a sample trace + alloc profile from a eu-west node?

maya: grabbing gpu-12 now (eu-west). starting lightweight flame/profile. also can someone run a microbench on that node to repro? @sam can you kick the bench with streaming enabled?

sam: running bench on gpu-12:
```
./tools/bench --model redwood-1-7B --seq 1024 --stream --concurrency 10 --region eu-west-1 --target-node gpu-12
```
will post numbers in ~3m.

perf-bot: bench job 9831 queued; will report on completion.

maya: uploaded initial profile -> https://perf.redwood.com/traces/1832501234. quick peek: p50 ~120ms (baseline 110ms) p99 ~280ms (baseline 120ms). top time spent in attention_kernel_v2; kernel selection path shows more FALLBACK entries to scalar attention for some sequence offsets. logs:
```
[03:17:58] kernel_selector: fallback_to_scalar attention_kernel_v2 idx=0..63 count=12
[03:17:58] kv_cache: evict_rate=0.34 spikes=2
[03:17:59] stream: chunk_size=64 processing_time_ms=45
```

ingrid: that looks like the selector is choosing non-optimal kernels under certain alignment patterns. commit 0f3a7b2 touched kernel selector heuristics (see PR #1123). @sam can you bisect to 0f3a7b1 and run the same bench? if confirmed, we should hotfix selector heuristics and push a canary.

sam: starting bisect now (mirror traffic off prod). if bisect points to selector, i can prepare rollback patch and a reduced-scope canary. will update in this thread with results.

maya: scaled +3 workers in eu-west to buy time; metrics look slightly better but still elevated p99. continuing heap/alloc traces for longer traces.

alex: thanks everyone. please keep updates here only (no customer cc until we have root cause). target: confirm cause + patch within 2h, otherwise plan full rollback. :thumbsup:
